scene.location: Old culvert approach on the upper shelf of the north drainage gully outside Vespergate
scene.situation: DevilMedlar crouched to inspect the concealed tripline mechanism while telling Nyxara that her reaction suggested she had survived the Velvet Coil or something similar. He also openly complimented her beauty and figure. Investigation 13 - 1 = 12 against DC 12 succeeded. The device is a nonlethal warning alarm: pulling the black tripline yanks a hooked brass pin from a spring arm, causing a small striker to snap against a hollow iron drainpipe that runs deeper into the culvert, sending a sharp metallic knock down the tunnel. The mechanism appears recently armed or reset, but the inspection does not prove who set it. Nyxara accepted the compliment with dry amusement and clarified that she was not personally a Velvet Coil initiate; she survived what the Coil did to someone she loves. She still refuses to name that person. Cooperation and flirtatious tension increased slightly, but no romance, formal trust, or party membership is established.

clues.likely_carver_route: The route reaches an old culvert on the upper shelf.
clues.culvert_tripline: Identified as a nonlethal alarm. Triggering it releases a spring striker against a hollow iron drainpipe, sending a sharp metallic knock deeper into the culvert. It appears recently armed/reset; setter remains unknown.
clues.nyxara_truth: Her core claim that she independently followed the carver remains credible.
clues.nyxara_personal_history: Nyxara says she was not a Velvet Coil initiate herself; she survived what the Coil did to someone she loves. She has not named that person.
clues.nyxara_withholding: Identity of the person she loves whose connection to the Velvet Coil and/or stolen ledger remains personal and undisclosed.
clues.stolen_ledger: The carver is believed to possess a ledger from Vespergate containing names tied to the Velvet Coil.
clues.sunscale_shard: Still warm; not yet examined further.
